findings.text: session_override_global renders '全局{global}' with no separator — '全局：{global}' or '全局为{global}' reads cleaner; '本会话现为auto' (card.notice_session_auto) is slightly bookish but matches relay.asks.gate.notice_auto's '现为auto', so it is consistent and not a defect.
